title: created three tasks on nosecretformula.vercel.app
source_description: User can list all tasks ordered by due date, with overdue tasks pinned to the top
steps: Navigate to https://nosecretformula.vercel.app/
Verify the acceptance criterion
expected_result:
Opened nosecretformula.vercel.app and went to the Tasks page.
Used the “Add a task” form to create three tasks: “Overdue 002” (2026-05-10), “Soon 002” (2026-05-18), and “Later 002” (2026-05-25).
Viewed the task list and confirmed the tasks were ordered by due date with “Overdue 002” pinned at the top as the overdue item.
Stopped after verification and left the tasks in place.
kane_objective: On https://nosecretformula.vercel.app/ — Step 1 (SETUP): create three test tasks using the Add a task form: (a) title "Overdue 002" with due date 2026-05-10, (b) title "Soon 002" with due date 2026-05-18, (c) title "Later 002" with due date 2026-05-25. Step 2 (VERIFY): confirm the task list shows these three tasks ordered by due date with "Overdue 002" pinned to the top because its due date is in the past. Stop after verification — do not delete the tasks.
